title: raw_buf + decode_utf8_chunk: correct split-codepoint handling with tests
description: The two-buffer approach (raw_buf for bytes, buf for decoded UTF-8) with decode_utf8_chunk correctly handles multi-byte UTF-8 codepoints split across adjacent HTTP chunks. This is a genuine correctness concern that naive implementations get wrong. The six targeted unit tests (including a regression test for the incomplete-head-retained bug) give it real coverage. Don't simplify this — the test names explain why each case exists.
